ledger.x: 6 March 1898: 'on 6 March 1898, the German Empire retreated from outright cession of the area and accepted a leasehold of the bay for 99 years, or until 1997'; the Reichstag ratified on 8 April 1898 and Kiautschou was placed under imperial protection on 27 April.

7 November 1914: 'On 7 November 1914, the bay was occupied by Japanese forces'; the Siege of Tsingtao page: the fortress 'surrendered to the Japanese forces' on 7 November, after a siege 'between 27 August and 7 November 1914', and 'The Allies took formal possession of the colony on 16 November 1914'.

wars.name: Siege of Tsingtao
wars.outcome: Japanese victory: the fortress surrendered on 7 November 1914 after a siege from 27 August; the garrison of 3,625 under Governor Meyer-Waldeck was taken.

certainty.note: Fixed by the 1898 lease, but no page gives the line; the 18 km radius is a stand-in within 10 percent of the page's 552 km2.
